posts.text: Arizona is one of the states hit hardest by Republicans’ vote to take away ACA tax credits. This means many families are going uninsured because they can’t afford increasing health insurance premiums. I’ll keep fighting to fix this – families are counting on it.
posts.summary: Opposes Republican ACA tax credit cuts, commits to fight for affordable insurance

posts.text: Congress overwhelmingly passed a bipartisan bill to lower housing costs and make homeownership more affordable in Arizona and across the country. But Trump called it a “big yawn” and is still refusing to sign the bill into law. American families need this relief, and they need it now.
posts.summary: Backs bipartisan housing affordability bill, criticizes Trump's refusal to sign

posts.text: Money in politics is breaking our democracy, and this week’s Supreme Court decision only opened the door for more spending. Washington won't tackle problems for working families as long as billionaires and corporations can continue buying elections. Get money out of politics, and we can actually fix things.
posts.summary: Criticizes Supreme Court decision enabling corporate campaign spending, demands money out of politics

While working Americans are struggling to make ends meet, Trump enriched himself to the tune of $2.2 billion last year. 

A foreign government bought into his crypto business and then got a sweetheart deal from his administration.  Who is he really working for? This is textbook corruption.
